description: Réseau de transport Trans'Agglo de DLVA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Durance Luberon Verdon Agglomération. La DLVA diffuse les données de transports des lignes d'autocars urbains et interurbains (horaires des Lignes avec les points d’arrêts, les calendriers, et les routes ) de son territoire extraites quotidiennement du réseau régional Zou!. Depuis 2019, les anciens réseaux Manobus et les lignes péri-urbaines sont réunis sous un seul nom, le Trans'Agglo. Coverage: Durance Luberon Verdon Agglomération. The publisher named on the listing is Durance Luberon Verdon Agglomération. Its keywords include reseau-de-transport, transport-en-commun, transagglo, mobilite, bus, autocar. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS, ZIP, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
